note: China: a foreign performer comes on the work visa (Z), for a commercial performance on an approval letter from the Culture and Tourism Bureau and an approval of short-term employment, otherwise on the Notice of Foreigner's Work Permit (China Visa Application Service Center's Z visa page, updated 24 August 2026). No days of such work without it are named. Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan keep their own rules. The Exit and Entry Administration Law itself wasn't read: the NPC's and the National Immigration Administration's pages didn't serve it to this client.

sources.title: Chinese Visa Application Service Center, Visa Category: (Z) Work (2026-08-24)
sources.said: Submit one of the following documents according to different circumstances： 1.Commercial performance: An approval letter by the relevant Culture and Tourism Bureau in China, and Approval of Short-term Employment for Foreigners working in P.R.China.
